subject: general
question: What organisation is hosting the six-day international festival on Indian dance from 16 October 2024 in Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangeet Natak Akademi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi hosted its first-ever International Festival on Indian Dance from 16th to 21st October 2024.
 
• The six-day festival was inaugurated by Gajendra Singh Shekhawat, Minister of Culture and Tourism.
 
• This event brought together artists, scholars, and students to explore the diversity of Indian dance forms.
 
• The festival is only the second such event in the history of Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• The event featured participants from 60 countries and was organized in collaboration with the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Seminars and Themes__

 __
 
• The event included 30 seminars covering topics like the evolution of Indian dance and the role of artificial intelligence in the arts.
 
• Other discussions focused on Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) funding for sustainable livelihoods in the arts.
 
 
 
• Exhibitions__
 __
 
• The Lalit Kala Akademi featured an exhibition on the history of the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• A.P. Shinde Symposium Hall showcased the achievements of participating artists.
